note: Every rule here is implemented in schema/semantic_validate.py with the same id and severity; verify_all fails if the two disagree.

noHeroReason.art-lab: One fixed full-viewport canvas; its title and description are visually hidden, so the page has no opening composition separate from the canvas.

rules.description: route must match the template routePattern
node sequence must match the declared template's node list (min/max per (section, variant))
a section with variants needs one of them; a section without variants takes none
exactly one HERO node, except NO_HERO_TEMPLATES
the HERO is the first in-flow content node (sticky nav and fixed overlays excluded)
sections with mustBeLastContent close the in-flow content (footer excluded)
when a case study uses part openers, its first chapter is one (observed on both case studies that use them)
partLabel/partTitle only on part-opener chapters, and required there
each interactive demo kind appears at most once per page
a count-up stat value must contain a number (the count-up parser needs one)
legal clause labels are parenthesised uppercase, e.g. (HOSTING)
prices are a currency sign followed by a number
text over the field's measured maxWords
motion pattern not allowed for the section
reducedMotionFallback differs from the pattern's pinned fallback
asset role not allowed for this field in this mode
retrievalEligible disagrees with the pinned RETRIEVAL_INELIGIBLE set
style value is not a catalog token
raw hex/rgb/hsl/named colour in a style field
raw length in a spacing field
font outside token-policy allowedFonts
token category not allowed for the style field
surface not allowed for the section
text token not allowed on that surface
source brand / wordmark / domain-name variants in a generated page
the real owner's name or handles in a generated page
real client, collaborator or third-party company names in a generated page
source URLs, e-mails, social profiles, endpoints or non-reserved hosts in a generated page
source copy (distinctive phrases or any shared 6-word sequence) in a generated page
source-specific CTA strings in a generated page
non-generation-safe asset role or a source asset path in a generated page
the owner's portrait / likeness role in a generated page
award badges, rankings or rating claims taken from the source in a generated page

adjacency.case-study: role -> (context) -> process -> chapters (3-10) -> next-project, observed on all four case studies; context absent on one.
adjacency.home: hero -> studio band -> projects -> art-lab teaser -> skillset (night) -> lead form (night)
